result.rationale: The Rs 43.14 crore first export PO is firm and equals 31.4% of FY26 revenue of Rs 137.42 crore. It is not routine: it is the company's first export order and opens South Africa after vendor qualification in April 2026, while earlier Indian tender awards were L1 or qualified with no stated value. result.what_changed: On 30 May 2026 the company disclosed its first export PO of about Rs 43.14 crore, equal to 31.4% of FY26 revenue of Rs 137.42 crore, after South African vendor qualification in April 2026. Other items in the window are small or not firm: a Rs 7.18 crore PO (5.2% of revenue, 25 May), a Rs 5.16 lakh Nepal order, and a CMSS item that is a qualified tender with no value.
contradictions: The Rs 43.14 crore is described as a first export order, while earlier Indian tender awards (CMSS, 2025-26) were L1 or qualified with no stated value and are not firm
Recurrence is not stated: a government tender allocation may be one-off, and the delivery period is not given
result.next_milestone: Dispatch and delivery against the South African PO, and any follow-on allocation or extension under the RT75-2025 transversal contract
